$2^{x-1} - 1 = 0$
$\Rightarrow 2^{x-1} = 1 = 2^0$
$\Rightarrow x-1 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x = 1$

cau.loi_giai:
$\dfrac{4}{21} + \dfrac{3}{14} \left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{12}{7}$
$\dfrac{3}{14} \left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{12}{7} - \dfrac{4}{21}$
$\dfrac{3}{14} \left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{32}{21}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{32}{21} : \dfrac{3}{14}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{32}{21} \cdot \dfrac{14}{3}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{2} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{64}{9}$
TH1: $\dfrac{1}{2} - x = \dfrac{8}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{8}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{-13}{6}$
TH2: $\dfrac{1}{2} - x = -\dfrac{8}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{2} - \left( -\dfrac{8}{3} \right)$
$x = \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{8}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{19}{6}$
Vậy $x \in \left\{ \dfrac{-13}{6} ; \dfrac{19}{6} \right\}$.

cau.ten_dang: Tìm x liên quan đến luỹ thừa với số mũ tự nhiên của số hữu tỉ
cau.loi_giai:
$\dfrac{1}{8} + \dfrac{5}{6} \left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{16}{3}$
$\dfrac{5}{6} \left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{16}{3} - \dfrac{1}{8}$
$\dfrac{5}{6} \left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{125}{24}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{125}{24} : \dfrac{5}{6}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{125}{24} \cdot \dfrac{6}{5}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{3} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{25}{4}$
TH1: $\dfrac{1}{3} - x = \dfrac{5}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{3} - \dfrac{5}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{-13}{6}$
TH2: $\dfrac{1}{3} - x = -\dfrac{5}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{3} - \left( -\dfrac{5}{2} \right)$
$x = \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{5}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{17}{6}$
Vậy $x \in \left\{ \dfrac{-13}{6} ; \dfrac{17}{6} \right\}$.

cau.ten_dang: Tìm x liên quan đến luỹ thừa với số mũ tự nhiên của số hữu tỉ
cau.loi_giai:
$\dfrac{1}{32} + \dfrac{3}{8} \left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{31}{128}$
$\dfrac{3}{8} \left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{31}{128} - \dfrac{1}{32}$
$\dfrac{3}{8} \left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{27}{128}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{27}{128} : \dfrac{3}{8}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{27}{128} \cdot \dfrac{8}{3}$
$\left( \dfrac{1}{4} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{9}{16}$
TH1: $\dfrac{1}{4} - x = \dfrac{3}{4}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{3}{4}$
$x = \dfrac{-1}{2}$
TH2: $\dfrac{1}{4} - x = -\dfrac{3}{4}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{4} - \left( -\dfrac{3}{4} \right)$
$x = \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{3}{4}$
$x = 1$
Vậy $x \in \left\{ \dfrac{-1}{2} ; 1 \right\}$.

cau.ten_dang: Tìm x liên quan đến luỹ thừa với số mũ tự nhiên của số hữu tỉ
cau.loi_giai:
$\dfrac{1}{9} + \dfrac{2}{7} \left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{7}$
$\dfrac{2}{7} \left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{7} - \dfrac{1}{9}$
$\dfrac{2}{7} \left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{2}{63}$
$\left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{2}{63} : \dfrac{2}{7}$
$\left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{2}{63} \cdot \dfrac{7}{2}$
$\left( \dfrac{5}{6} - x \right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{9}$
TH1: $\dfrac{5}{6} - x = \dfrac{1}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{5}{6} - \dfrac{1}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{2}$
TH2: $\dfrac{5}{6} - x = -\dfrac{1}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{5}{6} - \left( -\dfrac{1}{3} \right)$
$x = \dfrac{5}{6} + \dfrac{1}{3}$
$x = \dfrac{7}{6}$
Vậy $x \in \left\{ \dfrac{1}{2} ; \dfrac{7}{6} \right\}$.
